name: score-gate-rollout
description: Code-driven gate: a judge scores a release candidate, a `code` phase turns that score into a discrete decision (ship / hold / block) by threshold, and a `switch` routes to the matching path. Showcases a deterministic `code` phase (no LLM, no tokens) feeding a `switch` — the natural pairing for value-based branching.

phases.name: evaluate

ship.name: deploy

hold.name: revise

default.name: block
